Why do other AI tools

fail?

They rely on manually-written instructions, missing the real reasoning logic and undocumented know-how your team relies on every day.

How are we

different?

Tymely learns how your agents actually reason

Tymely uncovers the implicit decision rules behind agent behavior, capturing the thousands of unwritten scenarios, edge cases, and nuanced judgments they rely on every day.

How?

We connect to the systems your agents use every day and capture real system-state snapshots from live interactions. Our proprietary AI Simulator then reverse-engineers the decision logic, revealing the actual reasoning your top agents use.
